prose: An Ask HN thread asks whether people use a subscribed LLM or a locally deployed open-source model, and why. The two replies so far split: one developer runs a model locally to test a project without paying per token, after exhausting Hugging Face's free API limit in 5 to 7 hours, and another uses a subscription for software engineering.
It is a tiny thread of a few comments, so it shows two anecdotes and no trend.
highlights: Ask HN poll: subscription versus local models
Local user avoids per-token costs while testing
Hugging Face free limit ran out in 5-7 hours
Subscriber uses it for software development
